title: CacheStatus
description: GET /cache-status — aggregate + per-root warm progress, live prefetcher state, capacity verdict, and in-flight scans. The RC bridge emits the normalized snake_case v1 form; capacity and scanning are always present.

roots.description: Per-pin-root summaries; always an array, empty when no pin roots.

rate_bytes_per_sec.description: Pinned bytes reaching the disk per second over the last 20 s; 0 when idle or stalled. ADDITIVE/optional (pin-before-travel).

eta_sec.description: Estimated seconds until every pinned byte is on disk: (aggregate.total_bytes - aggregate.cached_bytes) / rate_bytes_per_sec. 0 = done or unknown. ADDITIVE/optional.

pinned_block_bytes.description: Bytes JuiceFS holds as pinned blocks (exempt from cache eviction), from the last pin-guard pass. 0 when the JuiceFS cannot pin. ADDITIVE/optional.

pin_limit_bytes.description: JuiceFS's cap on pinned blocks: 90% of the cache size; the rest stays for ordinary reads. A pin past it fails with an 'insufficient cache capacity' error. ADDITIVE/optional.

live.description: Live prefetcher state (pin.LiveStats). Zero-valued when prefetcher is nil.

cache_used_bytes.description: TRUE total on-disk JuiceFS block-cache size in bytes — the honest 'cache used' number. Sourced from the juicefs_blockcache_bytes gauge (every block read, NOT only pinned), falling back to a du of the cache dir when the gauge is unavailable. This is a SUPERSET of aggregate.cached_bytes (which is pinned-resident only). Consumers should display this as 'cache used' (pair with capacity.cache_capacity_bytes), and treat aggregate.cached_bytes/total_bytes strictly as the pinned-resident readiness fraction. ADDITIVE/optional: an older core omits this field (decode as 0); no contract_version bump.
cache_used_bytes.$comment: Optional (not in required) so a pre-fix core that omits it still validates.

cache_capacity_bytes.description: Most the cache can sustainably hold: min(disk free + cache usage - floor, cache_budget_bytes). 0 when unknown: no FUSE mount has admitted a cache policy yet (for example a launch with the backend unreachable). While unknown, shortfall_bytes is 0 and over_capacity is false; disk_free_bytes, cache_usage_bytes and pinned_bytes stay real.

cache_free_floor_bytes.description: Effective JuiceFS free-space eviction floor selected at mount time; clients use this instead of a hard-coded percentage when reporting cache suspension or pressure.

cache_budget_bytes.description: Configured JuiceFS cache-size budget, or 0 when unknown or unlimited.

computed_sec.description: Unix seconds the verdict was computed.

scanning.description: pin.ScanningRoot[] (scanning.go:24) — in-flight pin-tree scans. Normalized to [] (never null).

prefetching_files.description: Files being downloaded now. Their bytes already on disk count in cached_bytes. ADDITIVE/optional (pin-before-travel).

cached_bytes.description: Bytes on disk of ready files plus the bytes already on disk of files being downloaded (byte-level pin progress).
